captions.detailed: A black swing-arm desk lamp featuring a C-clamp base mount with a light grey adjustable screw. A vertical post rises from the clamp and connects to a long, horizontal cylindrical boom arm via a swiveling revolute joint. At the end of this boom, a tiltable joint holds a conical black lamp shade reflector. The primary body parts are matte black, while the joint collars and clamp screw are finished in a contrasting light grey.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated swing-arm desk lamp. It should feature a C-clamp base, a horizontal boom arm connected via a revolute joint, and a conical reflector shade at the end connected via a tilt joint. Apply a black material to the main body and a light grey material to the clamp screw and joint collars.
captions.factory: Construct the C-clamp base using box and cylinder primitives to form the C-frame and the clamp screw. Model the vertical post as a cylinder. Build the horizontal boom arm as a long cylinder, attaching it to the post with a collar. Create the lamp head assembly by modeling a conical shade (using a loft or hollowed cone/cylinder combination) attached to a rectangular hinge bracket. Connect the parts using an ArticulatedObject structure, defining a revolute joint for the horizontal boom rotation and a tilt joint for the lamp shade.
